title: Map QQ16 numerical contracts and remaining caller costs
body:
## Summary

The QQ16 observation map predates the zero-retention decoder's numerical chain. Add a source-pinned successor that explains exactly what the completed-error, rounded-line, finite-format, pair-circuit and common-scale results supply, with the remaining complete-caller obligations.

```text
docs/research/qq16-numerical-contract-map.md
research/qq16-numerical-contract-navigation/
```

The map keeps relative Hilbert error, component width, Boolean gates and physical costs distinct. It cross-checks the shared 456-bit format / 453-bit operand example and the scan-plus-pair subtotal. PR2876 remains pending at its exact head. Scope is navigation and source binding; no supplier admission or new kappa.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the six-contract observation map sends later native-line work outside its index.
  **After:** the bottleneck brief and observation map link to the five-result numerical chain, exact heads, attribution and a bounded caller handoff.
- Four retained numerical primary checkers and exact-head PR2876's primary checker pass. Commands, environment and outputs are in `REPLAY.json`; full predecessor suites and the selected cold replay were not run.
- Registered navigation replay passes normally and under `-O`, including seven rejecting controls. Eight metadata diagnostic tests, Ruff, compilation, publication-byte checks and clean application against refreshed main pass.
- Two internal read-only reviews checked numerical implications and the checker. A missing feedback-domain condition was corrected. No human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

[Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2727#discussioncomment-18968187). Task metadata records revision 5, the scoped consolidation assignment, source pins and refreshed overlap including closed PRs. Full predecessor credit is in the map and package.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Adds documentation and an opt-in binding replay. The selected frontier and frozen predecessor artifacts are unchanged. Physical realization, an admitted recursive tariff and a complete caller budget remain open.
